strings.zh: 欢迎光临！{NEWLINE}这里是彩虹餐厅。{CLEAR}我们现在正在举办大胃王比赛,{CLEAR}报名费2000元,{CLEAR}你要不要也来参加一下呢？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome! This is the Celadon{NEWLINE}Restaurant. We’re holding an eating{CLEAR}contest right now.{SCROLL}The entry fee is $2000. Would you like{NEWLINE}to join in?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 呼呼我吃我吃……{NEWLINE}呼呼我吃我吃……{SCROLL}我是个大胃王,{NEWLINE}这次比赛我赢定了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Huff, huff, munch, munch... Huff, huff,{NEWLINE}munch, munch...{SCROLL}I’m a champion eater. I’ve got this{NEWLINE}contest in the bag!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我吃,唔咕咕,嗯我吃！{NEWLINE}（现在不能搭话！）{SCROLL}拼命吃,唔咕……{NEWLINE}（好像要从嘴里喷出来了……）{SCROLL}
strings.en: Chomp, chew, munch...{NEWLINE}(Please don’t talk to me now!){SCROLL}Chomp, chew, cough...{NEWLINE}(Food is gonna come out of my mouth...){SCROLL}

strings.zh: 啪咕啪咕啪咕！{SCROLL}……哎？这里是{NEWLINE}大胃王比赛的会场？{SCROLL}糟糕！{SCROLL}我还以为是{NEWLINE}这里是比速食比赛……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Munch munch munch...{NEWLINE}...What? This is the eatathon contest?{SCROLL}Ouch!{SCROLL}I thought it was the speed-eating{NEWLINE}contest...{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 咕噜咕噜……{SCROLL}我还能吃！{SCROLL}再来一份树果！老板！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Crunch... Crunch...{SCROLL}I can keep eating! More Berries, chef!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0510/4 | RV024: omission: 再来一份树果 names the Berries

strings.zh: 咕噜咕噜……{SCROLL}你在这家店是不会有人{NEWLINE}给你代币盒的。{CLEAR}到城都地区找找吧。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Crunch... Crunch...{SCROLL}Nobody at this restaurant is going to{NEWLINE}give you a Coin Case.{SCROLL}Try looking in Johto.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US line was a duplicate of #4; retranslated from the zh.

strings.zh: 我吃我吃,{NEWLINE}居然有大胃王比赛{CLEAR}这样的好事！{CLEAR}真是太幸福了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Munch, munch! An eating contest? What{NEWLINE}a wonderful thing! I’m so happy!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 大胃王比赛是一场{NEWLINE}没有时间限制,{CLEAR}没有终结的战斗！{CLEAR}第１名将免去餐费！
strings.en: Eatathon Contest!{NEWLINE}No time limit!{CLEAR}A battle without end!{SCROLL}The biggest eater gets it{NEWLINE}all for free!

strings.zh: 小蓝『我刚刚在餐厅里听说,{NEWLINE}彩虹市有一个秘密的拍卖行,{CLEAR}专门高价拍卖珍稀的精灵。{SCROLL}小蓝『我感觉偷臭臭花的人{NEWLINE}很可能是把它拿去那里卖了。
strings.en: Green: I just heard in the restaurant{NEWLINE}that there’s a secret auction house in{CLEAR}Celadon City that auctions rare Pokémon{CLEAR}for big money.{SCROLL}Green: I’ve got a feeling whoever stole{NEWLINE}Gloom probably took it there to sell.

strings.zh: 小赤『我刚刚在餐厅里听说,{NEWLINE}彩虹市有一个秘密的拍卖行,{CLEAR}专门高价拍卖珍稀的精灵。{SCROLL}小赤『我感觉偷臭臭花的人{NEWLINE}很可能是把它拿去那里卖了。
strings.en: Red: I just heard in the restaurant{NEWLINE}that there’s a secret auction house in{CLEAR}Celadon City that auctions rare Pokémon{CLEAR}for big money.{SCROLL}Red: I’ve got a feeling whoever stole{NEWLINE}Gloom probably took it there to sell.

strings.zh: 那真是太遗憾了。
strings.en: That’s too bad.

strings.zh: 你身上的这点钱{NEWLINE}好像不够参赛的呀。
strings.en: It looks like you don’t have enough{NEWLINE}money to enter.

strings.zh: 好的,您的参赛费我收下了,{NEWLINE}现在请您听清楚参赛规则：{CLEAR}本餐厅的大胃王比赛,{CLEAR}是比谁吃的多的比赛。{CLEAR}但是餐厅只提供最初的10个大树果{CLEAR}作为初始食物,{CLEAR}您想要吃更多的食物,{CLEAR}就必须通过精灵对战{CLEAR}从其他选手那赢过来才行。{SCROLL}如果您能击败{NEWLINE}我们餐厅里的所有参赛者,{CLEAR}并把赢来的大树果都吃掉,{CLEAR}那您一定可以成为本次比赛的大胃王。
strings.en: All right, I’ve received your entry fee.{SCROLL}Now please listen carefully to the{NEWLINE}rules.{SCROLL}Our restaurant’s eating contest is{NEWLINE}about who can eat the most. But we only{CLEAR}provide 10 Sitrus Berries to start.{SCROLL}If you want more food, you have to win{NEWLINE}it from the other contestants in{CLEAR}Pokémon battles.{SCROLL}If you can beat every contestant in the{NEWLINE}restaurant and eat all the Sitrus{CLEAR}Berries you win, you’re sure to be{CLEAR}crowned champion eater.

strings.zh: 您好,我们的比赛规则是：{NEWLINE}餐厅提供最初的10个大树果{CLEAR}作为初始食物,{CLEAR}您想要吃更多的食物,{CLEAR}就必须通过精灵对战{CLEAR}从其他选手那赢过来才行。{SCROLL}如果您能击败{NEWLINE}我们餐厅里的所有参赛者,{CLEAR}并把赢来的大树果都吃掉,{CLEAR}那您一定可以成为本次比赛的大胃王。
strings.en: Hello! Our contest rules are: the{NEWLINE}restaurant provides 10 Sitrus Berries{CLEAR}to start.{SCROLL}If you want more food, you have to win{NEWLINE}it from the other contestants in{CLEAR}Pokémon battles.{SCROLL}If you can beat every contestant in the{NEWLINE}restaurant and eat all the Sitrus{CLEAR}Berries you win, you’re sure to be{CLEAR}crowned champion eater.

strings.zh: 这是您的大树果,请收好。{NEWLINE}祝您比赛愉快。
strings.en: Here are your Sitrus Berries. Enjoy the{NEWLINE}contest.

strings.zh: 哇哇哇,您已经赢下{NEWLINE}并吃掉了这么多大树果了啊！{CLEAR}厉害厉害,以您的饭量{CLEAR}整个关东地区也没有人能比得上。{CLEAR}大胃王的称号您当之无愧。{CLEAR}这是您本次比赛的奖品——{CLEAR}树果套装礼盒,{CLEAR}请您收好。
strings.en: Wow, wow, wow! You’ve already won and{NEWLINE}eaten so many Sitrus Berries! Amazing!{SCROLL}With an appetite like yours, no one in{NEWLINE}all of Kanto can compare. You truly{CLEAR}deserve the title of champion eater.{SCROLL}Here’s your prize for this contest: a{NEWLINE}Berry Set gift box. Please take it.

strings.zh: 本餐厅的大胃王比赛常年举行,{NEWLINE}欢迎您下次再来参赛。
strings.en: Our restaurant holds its eating contest{NEWLINE}all year round. Please come and compete{CLEAR}again next time.

strings.zh: 我的树果都被你抢走了,{NEWLINE}没得吃了……
strings.en: You took all my Berries. Now I’ve got{NEWLINE}nothing to eat...

strings.zh: 你就带了这么几个树果,{NEWLINE}打赢你我也得不到多少,{CLEAR}我才不跟你比呢。
strings.en: You only brought a few Berries. I{NEWLINE}wouldn’t get much even if I beat you.{CLEAR}I’m not battling you.

strings.zh: 你也是参赛选手吗？{NEWLINE}那就跟我来场对战吧,{CLEAR}赢的人交出树果！
strings.en: Are you a contestant too?{SCROLL}Then battle me! The winner takes the{NEWLINE}loser’s Berries!

strings.zh: 没办法……我的树果归你了。
strings.en: Oh well... My Berries are yours.

strings.zh: 嘻嘻,是我赢了,{NEWLINE}树果给我吧。
strings.en: Tee-hee, I win. Hand over your Berries.

strings.zh: 本来我吃的就慢,{NEWLINE}还被你抢了这么多。{CLEAR}唉……
strings.en: I’m a slow eater to begin with, and you{NEWLINE}took so many from me. Sigh...

strings.zh: 你带的树果太少了,{NEWLINE}跟你打没啥意义。
strings.en: You’ve got too few Berries. There’s no{NEWLINE}point in battling you.

strings.zh: 我正愁树果快吃完了该怎么办呢,{NEWLINE}既然你也是参赛选手,{CLEAR}那就跟我来一场赌上树果的对战吧！
strings.en: I was just worrying about running out{NEWLINE}of Berries. Since you’re a contestant{CLEAR}too, let’s have a battle with our{CLEAR}Berries on the line!

strings.zh: 输了,我的树果是你的了。
strings.en: I lost. My Berries are yours.

strings.zh: 按照约定,你的树果我就收下了。
strings.en: As we agreed, I’ll take your Berries.

strings.zh: 啊啊啊啊,我宝贝的树果——{NEWLINE}没有啦……
strings.en: Aaah! My precious Berries... are{NEWLINE}gone...

strings.zh: 我看你包里没啥货,{NEWLINE}不是来骗我树果的吧？
strings.en: I don’t see much in your Bag. You’re{NEWLINE}not here to trick me out of my Berries,{CLEAR}are you?

strings.zh: 10个树果根本不够吃的,{NEWLINE}你要是愿意通过对战来送树果,{CLEAR}那我可是感激不尽！
strings.en: 10 Berries aren’t nearly enough to eat.{NEWLINE}If you want to give me Berries by{CLEAR}battling, I’d be very grateful!

strings.zh: 结果成了我给你送树果了……
strings.en: Instead, I ended up giving you{NEWLINE}Berries...

strings.zh: 哈哈,谢谢你的树果。
strings.en: Ha ha, thanks for the Berries.

strings.zh: 被赢走的树果{NEWLINE}我可再也变不出来啦。
strings.en: I can’t magic back the Berries you won{NEWLINE}from me.

strings.zh: 你没有多少树果吧,{NEWLINE}是想来我这空手套白狼吗？
strings.en: You don’t have many Berries, do you?{SCROLL}Are you trying to get something for{NEWLINE}nothing?

strings.zh: 只要再从你那里赢几个树果,{NEWLINE}我就能变一个大的树果魔术了。
strings.en: If I win just a few more Berries from{NEWLINE}you, I can do a big Berry magic trick.

strings.zh: 啊……我的树果被你变没了。
strings.en: Ah... You made my Berries disappear.

strings.zh: 你再看看你的背包,{NEWLINE}是不是少了几个树果？{CLEAR}哈哈,那都是被我变没的！
strings.en: Check your Bag again. Aren’t you{NEWLINE}missing a few Berries? Ha ha, I made{CLEAR}them all vanish!

strings.zh: 没有树果可吃,只能吃土了……
strings.en: No Berries to eat... Guess I’ll have to{NEWLINE}eat dirt...

strings.zh: 别看你包里鼓鼓的,{NEWLINE}那些根本不是树果吧。{CLEAR}我的鼻子对吃的可灵敏了,{CLEAR}你骗不了我。
strings.en: Your Bag may look stuffed, but those{NEWLINE}aren’t Berries, are they? My nose is{CLEAR}really sharp when it comes to food. You{CLEAR}can’t fool me.

strings.zh: 哈哈哈,我的树果快吃完了,{NEWLINE}正好再从你那里赢一点！
strings.en: Ha ha ha!{SCROLL}I’m almost out of Berries. Perfect{NEWLINE}timing to win some more from you!

strings.zh: 我仅存的树果……给你吧。
strings.en: My last Berries... Take them.

strings.zh: 太棒了,新鲜的树果吃起来！
strings.en: Awesome! Time to dig into some fresh{NEWLINE}Berries!

strings.zh: 妙蛙花『Venu——sau！
strings.en: Venusaur: Venu-sau!
